description: This is an HTML source file that defines the structure, styles, and client-side interactivity of a web-based database visualizer application. It includes layout for database and table navigation, data display tables, and JavaScript logic for fetching and rendering database data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data in a grid.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a table cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand/collapse.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated preview.
